user_story: As a guest, I want the system to reject a booking with 0 guests so that only valid guest counts are accepted.

positive.title: System accepts a booking with one or more guests
steps: Enter valid guest count as 1 or more.
Complete the rest of the booking details.
positive.expected_result: The booking is accepted and a confirmation is provided.

negative.title: System rejects a booking with 0 guests
steps: Complete the rest of the booking details.
negative.expected_result: The booking is rejected with an error message indicating 0 guests is not acceptable.

edge.title: System handling of maximum guests booking
steps: Enter guest count as the maximum allowed (e.g., 100 depending on system constraints).
Complete the rest of the booking details.
edge.expected_result: The booking is accepted at maximum limit and a confirmation is provided without any errors.
